label: soak only, with slow-upload logging
note: repeats only the 1-hour soak (scenarios off, no idle wake test) on a commit that adds only diagnostic logging over run 2: since f08ec93 the cloud is unchanged, the device only times and logs live uploads (3f2a988) and the test tools only write the latency CSV and summaries; the scenario results remain those of runs 1 and 2. 0 of 3,570 online windows over 5 s (max 4,074 ms, window 2761, ending 01:09:49.812 IST). The device logged 6 live uploads acknowledged after more than 2 s (max 4,267 ms), each in 1 attempt and with the whole wait before the first response byte; connect took 0-1 ms in five of them (which suggests an already-open connection; that is inferred from the connect time, not measured) and 19 ms in the first upload of the run; in 2 of them the cloud finished storing the batch 2.2 s and 3.8 s after the device began sending, in 3 it stored it within 0.18 s and the reply took 1.8-4.1 s more to arrive, and the first upload of the run (00:23:51 IST, right after the cloud woke) has no window to compare with. Where the wait occurred inside each of those legs (network, Render's proxy, the cloud process or Neon) is not recorded
